stops.title: Yu ovavyu
stops.caption: Ɔl di branch wan tɛm.
stops.speech: Dis na di admin vyu. Chɔch Pɔls de kawnt ɔl di branch wan tɛm, ɛn Nid Yu de lis wetin de wet fɔ sɔmbɔdi tide.

stops.title: Branch dɛn
stops.caption: Mek dɛn, grup dɛn, pul dɛn.
stops.speech: Branch na yu yon nɔmɔ. Na admin nɔmɔ kin mek wan, muv am to ɔda rijɔn, ɔ pul am awt pan di aktiv wan dɛn.

stops.title: Insay wan branch
stops.caption: In ditel, ɛn udat de lid am.
stops.speech: Opin wan branch fɔ sɛt in ditel ɛn in lidaship. We yu nem di mayn pasto ya, dat de gi am say pan dat branch in sefgadin kyu.

stops.title: Rijɔn dɛn
stops.caption: Di ples dɛn we de grup yu branch.
stops.speech: Rijɔn de grup branch bay ples. Mek di rijɔn fɔs; yu nɔ kin mek branch te di rijɔn de.

stops.title: Di aproval kyu
stops.caption: Nɔbɔdi nɔ de ɛnta te sɔmbɔdi opin fɔ am.
stops.speech: Ɛnibɔdi we sayn ɔp insɛf de wet ya. Aprov am ɛn i gɛt ful mɛmba akses; rifyuz am ɛn dɛn pul di akawnt.

stops.title: Udat ol wetin
stops.caption: Na grant, nɔto job taytul.
stops.speech: Opin wan mɛmba fɔ manej in grant dɛn. Kairos de sev tu sistem rol nɔmɔ, so ɔltin ɛls de kam frɔm grant.

stops.title: Mɛmbaship klas dɛn
stops.caption: Chɔch-wayd, so no branch grant nɔ de rich am.
stops.speech: Di mɛmbaship program na chɔch-wayd. Kɔhɔt de tek pipul frɔm ɛvri branch, so fɔ administa am, yu nid chɔch-skop grant.

stops.title: Ripɔt akrɔs branch
stops.caption: Di onli vyu we de tan branch wit branch.
stops.speech: Ripɔt na di krɔs-branch vyu. Na yu nɔmɔ as rol kin si ɛvri branch sayd bay sayd, nɔto wan at a tɛm.

stops.title: Yu langwej
stops.caption: Kairos ɛn dis andbuk, insay fɔ langwej.
stops.speech: Kairos de tɔk Inglish, Frɛnch, Krio ɛn Twi. Chenj am frɔm di saydba, ɛn di andbuk de opin insay di sem langwej.
